spec._doc: Gesture spec for the processional hero idle at 144 px (DESIGN.md section 1, revision 3; ART-RULES.md sections 2-5). Units: 'h' = height in px above the sole, 'dx' = px from the body centre line at the feet (+ = screen-right, the side she faces). Angles in degrees. This is the artist's thumbnail in data: tools/art-construct/figure_construct.py builds the wireframe, mannequin, silhouette, block-in and pixels from it. The 3D render (--ref) is only a reference layer. Every number here is [I] until the learning log (ART-RULES section 10) confirms it.
spec.name: idle_hero

zones._doc: polygons in dx/h (the checker converts). keep_out: nothing of the named kind may be inside. must_be: the named thing must be there.

keep_out.name: between the eyes below the lash

spec._tilt_doc: tilt_deg = angle of the near->far line; + = the far (screen-right) side higher. Weight on the far leg: far hip up (+), shoulders the other way (-).

thumbnails.name: t1_base
thumbnails.idea: the spec as written: weight far leg, free knee back, glaive 17 deg out, hand on the collar

thumbnails.name: t2_wide
thumbnails.idea: wider stance, hip thrust one more px

thumbnails.name: t3_tilt
thumbnails.idea: push the contrapposto a step (FG-N09): shoulders -10, hips +10

thumbnails.name: t4_haft25
thumbnails.idea: glaive at 25 deg with the butt at the near toe (overlap) and a lower grip

thumbnails.name: t5_hiphand
thumbnails.idea: free hand on the far hip instead of the collar (A/B for the second arm window)

thumbnails.name: t6_control_upright
thumbnails.idea: control: level shoulders and hips, both knees straight (the mannequin the critics named); should score worst

_decisions: round C1 (2026-09-29), first pass: t5_hiphand and t4_haft25 kept on 9 silhouette rules; building t4 in full showed the fist could not reach the lower grip (GR-P05 3.2 px off the haft), so GR-P05 and GR-P09 joined the thumbnail score.

round C1, second pass (11 rules): t5_hiphand and t2_wide kept (11/11; largest arm-gap areas). The hero adopts t2's wider stance and keeps the collar hand (DESIGN 1); t5 (hand on the far hip) stays the A/B alternative for the critics; t4 dropped (grip out of reach).

log: gesture: joints from targets by IK; weight on the far foot
mannequin: rib cage and pelvis boxes on one spine; limbs as tapered cylinders
dressed, shaded (one key light from the upper front, the facing side) and outlined
